reader_summary.overview: This is Matt Reustle and today we are breaking down Olin Corporation. Olin is a key player in industrial chemicals but many of those chemicals are used in products that we encounter on a day-to-day basis. To break down Olin, I'm joined by Yinan Zhao from Pzena Investment Management.

key_points.text: Together we cover the chlor-alkali market, what it means to be the lowest-cost producer of a given commodity.
Please enjoy this breakdown of Olin Corp.
